```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
```

```{r}
filepath <- paste0(getwd(), "/data/")
```

# ACS

```{r}
# "HINS1","HINS2","HINS3","HINS4","HINS5","HINS6","HINS7",
cols <- c("STATE", "AGEP", "POVPIP", "PRIVCOV", "PUBCOV", "HICOV", "PWGTP")

acs_data_a <- read_csv(file.path(filepath, "/csv_pus/psam_pusa.csv"), col_select = all_of(cols), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(STATE = as.character(STATE))
acs_data_b <- read_csv(file.path(filepath, "/csv_pus/psam_pusb.csv"), col_select = all_of(cols), show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(STATE = as.character(STATE))

acs <- bind_rows(acs_data_a, acs_data_b)
glimpse(acs)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(acs))
```

```{r}
acs <- acs |>
  mutate(
    # recodes are 1/2; convert to 1/0
    insured  = ifelse(HICOV == 1, 1, 0),
    uninsured = ifelse(HICOV == 2, 1, 0),
    privcov = ifelse(PRIVCOV == 1, 1, 0),
    pubcov  = ifelse(PUBCOV == 1, 1, 0)
  ) |>
  filter(AGEP >= 18, AGEP <= 64, !is.na(POVPIP), !is.na(PWGTP))

acs <- acs |>
  filter(!is.na(POVPIP))

nrow(acs[acs$privcov == 0 & acs$pubcov == 0, ])
nrow(acs[acs$insured == 1,])
```

```{r}
non_expansion <- c(1, 12, 13, 20, 28, 45, 47, 48, 55, 56)

acs <- acs |>
  mutate(expansion = ifelse(STATE %in% non_expansion, 0, 1))
```

```{r}
cutoff <- 138
bandwidth <- 5

acs_local <- acs |>
  filter(POVPIP >= cutoff - bandwidth,
         POVPIP <= cutoff + bandwidth)
```

```{r}
acs_local |>
  mutate(side = ifelse(POVPIP < cutoff, "Below", "Above")) |>
  group_by(expansion, side) |>
  summarise(
    mean_uninsured = weighted.mean(uninsured, PWGTP),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
library(scales)

cutoff <- 138
bandwidth <- 1

plot_df <- acs |>
  filter(POVPIP >= cutoff - bandwidth, POVPIP <= cutoff + bandwidth) |>
  mutate(side = ifelse(POVPIP < cutoff, "Below", "Above")) |>
  group_by(expansion, side) |>
  summarise(mean_uninsured = weighted.mean(uninsured, PWGTP),
            n = n(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    expansion = factor(expansion, levels = c(0,1),
                       labels = c("Non-expansion", "Expansion")),
    side = factor(side, levels = c("Below","Above"))
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = side, y = mean_uninsured, group = expansion)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ expansion) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Weighted Uninsured Rate Just Below vs Above 138% FPL",
    x = paste0("Within ±", bandwidth, "% FPL window around 138%"),
    y = "Uninsured rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
bin_width <- 2  # %FPL per bin

binned <- acs |>
  filter(POVPIP >= cutoff - bandwidth, POVPIP <= cutoff + bandwidth) |>
  mutate(
    bin = floor(POVPIP / bin_width) * bin_width + bin_width/2,
    side = ifelse(POVPIP < cutoff, "Below", "Above"),
    expansion = factor(expansion, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Non-expansion", "Expansion"))
  ) |>
  group_by(expansion, bin) |>
  summarise(
    mean_uninsured = weighted.mean(uninsured, PWGTP),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(binned, aes(x = bin, y = mean_uninsured)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(
    data = subset(binned, bin < cutoff),
    method = "lm", se = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = subset(binned, bin >= cutoff),
    method = "lm", se = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ expansion) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "RDD-Style Binned Uninsured Rates Around 138% FPL",
    x = "POVPIP (% of Federal Poverty Level)",
    y = "Binned uninsured rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
plot_df <- acs |>
  group_by(expansion, POVPIP) |>
  summarise(
    insured_rate = weighted.mean(insured, PWGTP),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    expansion = factor(expansion,
                       levels = c(0,1),
                       labels = c("Non-expansion", "Expansion"))
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = POVPIP, y = insured_rate, color = expansion)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", span = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Insurance Coverage Across Poverty Levels",
    x = "Percent of Federal Poverty Level (POVPIP)",
    y = "Insured Rate",
    color = "State Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = POVPIP, y = insured_rate, color = expansion)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", span = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(50, 250)) +
  labs(
    title = "Insurance Coverage Across Poverty Levels",
    x = "Percent of Federal Poverty Level (POVPIP)",
    y = "Insured Rate",
    color = "State Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~expansion, ncol = 1)
```
